languages.notes: Signals until the place's own language law and census are read.

laws.rule: Volcán de Agua: the official guide describes coordinating the Santa María de Jesús ascent with the municipal tourism office, or the Ciudad Vieja route with the municipal environmental-management unit and local tourism guide association. It recommends local guides and carrying rubbish out; no compulsory-guide or permit statute is inferred. A stray Retalhuleu/Manchón Guamuchal directions paragraph in the page is unrelated and was not used.

sources.title: Volcán de Agua: local ascent coordination
sources.authority: Consejo Nacional de Áreas Protegidas, Guatemala
sources.supports: Read directly: ascent via Santa María de Jesús coordinated with municipal tourism, or Ciudad Vieja through its environmental-management unit and local guide association; local guide and carry-out rubbish recommendations.

local-law.note: Named ascent coordination process, not a claim of current safety, no-fee/24-hour access or that every route is open.
